final_diagnostic_checks.scope: Additional exact-message and origin-note checks for partial cleanup and saved descendant aliases, using the existing frozen fixtures; full implementation suites and immutable binaries are unchanged.

summary_correction.reason: The summary scanner expected a single space before the passed count, but lit aligns that field. All three original invocations returned zero and explicitly reported the selected test PASS. Re-read those logs with whitespace-tolerant matching; no test rerun or source correction was needed.

provenance.transport: Mechanically derived from the frozen primary clients during implementation; compiler objects use the same files.
provenance.oracle: Generated from an independent concrete heap model during implementation and frozen before its first checker run.

transport_extraction.method: Deterministic interface extraction from the frozen primary tree.h, removing only static linkage and replacing includes in unchanged client bodies. Expectations and selections copied verbatim.

upstream.note: Frozen before RFC 0027 checker changes; lifecycle clients use the full unchanged pinned source.

limitations: Finite acyclic ownership forests; arbitrary graphs, shared ownership, concurrency and nonlocal control transfer remain unsupported.
Recursive consumption initially supports direct self recursion with one pointer argument and a void return; mutual recursive cleanup remains incomplete.

cJSON evidence covers explicit default hooks and the selected lifecycle clients, with complete unchanged definitions in each object client translation unit; parser/printer verification and cross-unit private mutable hook state are outside scope.
Metadata and timeout limits are unchanged; incomplete and iteration-limited corpus definitions remain visible.
